subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – Buy Now button link
body_text:
Hi Uday,

Thank you for speaking with us. You reached out because the Buy Now button on your sales page was sending people to the wrong page.

What was completed during the call:
- The Buy Now button on your sales page now goes to the right page, and you tested it and confirmed this.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-13

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
caveats: Who made the change to the Buy Now button was not established; the email states the result neutrally.
